plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: 131 SKILL.md skills — 1 workflow orchestrator + 66 refactorings + 24 smells + 40 patterns (27 Kerievsky + 13 GoF). Apply Fowler refactorings when their preconditions appear; refuse known code smells; apply Kerievsky composite refactorings whose destination is a pattern; recognize GoF design patterns as destination shapes. Sources: https://refactoring.com/catalog/, Refactoring to Patterns (Kerievsky 2004), and Design Patterns (Gamma/Helm/Johnson/Vlissides 1994).
